description: Search the text of every document postalref holds, or of one, for the pages that say the words, best first: those that say them as a phrase, then by how much of the page they are and how many of them it says side by side or close together, a table of contents last. A court's filing or a Justice Department release about a fraud case comes after USPS's own pages when one of those says every word, as Publication 52 and a release about a bulk mail fraud both say bulk mail permit; a case's name finds its records first. A document gives at most three pages while other documents' pages fill the list, and `more` gives each document a hit is from that has more pages with the words, and how many: grep again with /documents/<id> as `path` to rank only its pages. A page needn't have the words a question asks with, such as how, get or take. Each word is found in its forms, and a name also as the registry's other names for it, BCG for Business Customer Gateway or Post Office Box for PO Box, and a size as 4x6 or 4 x 6; a hit another wording found gives it as `by`. Each hit gives the path and page read reads, and the passage that says most of the words. Use it when no title names what you're looking for, as for a price in the Mail Classification Schedule or a rule in a DMM chapter. With /documents as `path`, it searches every document on PostalPro by title and file name instead, with its page and newest file, and the product pages and downloads postalref holds by title; each one postalref holds the text of carries the path read takes. A hit's `context` is a whole sentence, list or row of the page unless it starts or ends with …: quote it with the hit's `id` and `page`, or read its `path` at that `page` for the sentences around it. When no hit answers, grep again with the words an answer would say. A title says only that USPS publishes a document: read one grep lists to learn what it says.

limit.description: At most this many; 10 when absent.

path.description: Where to look: /documents/<id>, one document's pages, every one that says the words up to `limit`; or /documents, the titles of every PostalPro document and of the documents postalref holds. Every page of every document postalref holds when absent.

query.description: Words a page says: a price, a rule, a size, a name. Each word is found in its forms: one or many, -ed, -ing, -able, -ous. With /documents: words from a document's title or file name.

topic.description: With /documents: only documents a model put under this topic.

name: grep
title: Search the documents
